name: student-insight
description: Privacy-first, offline, in-browser student analytics. Static site, no build step, no backend. This file exists purely so dependency versions are visible to Dependabot/npm audit — nothing here is actually installed or bundled; all libraries load from pinned CDN <script> tags in index.html.

scripts.test:loader-cards: echo 'Needs a static file server on 127.0.0.1:8899 first, e.g.: python3 -m http.server 8899 --bind 127.0.0.1' && node dev-tests/verify-loader-cards.js
